name: xcloud
description: Deploy Git repositories, diagnose broken or slow sites, and manage xCloud hosting with nine capability skills. MCP-first with a technically GET-only REST fallback.
long_description: The xCloud agent skills let any AI agent (Claude Code and others) operate xCloud in plain language and finish the job: paste a GitHub URL and say deploy — the agent detects the app, previews the site with a dry run, asks once, provisions, polls, checks the live URL, and diagnoses and retries a failed deploy on the same site. The same proactive flow covers Docker Compose apps, one-click apps, Git staging environments, new WordPress sites and new servers, alongside day-2 work: SSL, backups, WordPress updates, vulnerability and broken-link scans, billing, mailboxes, incident alerts, and multi-team accounts. v4 is MCP-first: connect the xCloud MCP server (https://app.xcloud.host/mcp — OAuth, one tool per API operation plus two search tools, with per-action confirmation on destructive operations) and the skills use it automatically; agents without MCP fall back to the shared auth + curl layer. A legacy Python SDK and CLI remain under src/ for direct scripting.

features: MCP-first: pairs with the xCloud MCP server (one native tool per authenticated API operation, full API parity, plus agent and docs search)
OAuth connection — no raw token to store; per-action confirmation on destructive tools
Deploy any GitHub URL end to end: detect, dry-run preview, one approval, provision, verify, auto-diagnose and retry
Multi-team: one MCP connection or token across the teams you grant
Diagnose a site that errors (500/502, critical error) or is slow from evidence — logs, events, monitoring, cache layers, PageSpeed — with dashboard handoffs for what the API cannot switch
Nine capability skills: deploy, troubleshoot, performance, servers, sites, wordpress, ssl, billing, account
Plain-language operation — the agent routes to the right skill
Provision WordPress and Git-deployed sites (Laravel/Node/PHP); safe site deletion
Shared auth + curl wrapper as the REST fallback, no per-skill duplication
On-demand reference docs for large sub-resources
Proactive branded onboarding and safe API token setup guidance
Git deployment, team vulnerability rollup, and service-disable coverage
Legacy Python SDK, async helpers, and CLI under src/

environment.XCLOUD_API_TOKEN: REST fallback only — not needed when the xCloud MCP connector is used. Token from https://app.xcloud.host/settings/api-tokens

quick_start.1_connect_mcp: claude mcp add xcloud --transport http https://app.xcloud.host/mcp  then /mcp -> Authenticate (OAuth; no token needed)
quick_start.2_install: /plugin marketplace add xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills  then  /plugin install xcloud@xcloud-agent-skills
quick_start.3_fallback: No MCP support? Add {"env": {"XCLOUD_API_TOKEN": "your-token"}} to your Claude Code settings instead
quick_start.4_use: Ask in plain language, e.g. "List my xCloud servers" or "Renew SSL for example.com"

mcp_info.auth: OAuth (mcp:read / mcp:write) or Bearer token with mcp:invoke scope
mcp_info.notes: 188 operation tools (every agent-facing Public API operation, 2026-09-24) plus xcloud_agent_search and xcloud_docs_search; five-tool compact profile at ?profile=compact (alias /mcp/v2); toolset narrowing with ?toolsets=; destructive tools require per-action confirmation; multi-team via the team argument.

agent_support.monitoring: Fleet health checks, capacity planning, cost analysis
agent_support.security: SSL monitoring, vulnerability scans, firewall/fail2ban, site verification
agent_support.operations: Bulk updates, status reporting, disaster recovery

installation.mcp: claude mcp add xcloud --transport http https://app.xcloud.host/mcp
